confidence_notes: Food anchors rest on India- and Kerala-wide crowd-sourced estimates, not Munnar-specific menus. Beer and cappuccino have some direct, though indirect, data points. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the local beer price relationship because direct data was weak; wine is uncommon and heavily taxed in Kerala. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and seasonal hill-station context, with no live listings inspected. The FX observation came from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not independently checked on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kerala hill-station tourist towns, based on Kerala and India-wide estimates: Expatistan Kochi neighbourhood-pub beer, Numbeo-derived cappuccino and meal estimates republished by Combien-coûte.net and Preciosmundi, and Kerala retail beer prices, with an uplift for tourist-area pricing. Cocktail and wine are estimated from beer using a local price relationship.
